parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.companies) AS total_companies,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.leads WHERE qualification_level = 'high_priority') AS high_priority_leads,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.outreach_messages WHERE status = 'sent') AS emails_sent,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.email_replies) AS total_replies,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.email_replies WHERE classification IN ('interested', 'meeting_request')) AS positive_replies,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.opportunities WHERE stage = 'meeting_requested') AS meetings_requested,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deal_value), 0) FROM public.opportunities WHERE stage NOT IN ('won', 'lost')) AS pipeline_value,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.suppression_list) AS total_suppressed;
